experiences.job_description:
Invenco Cloud Services (ICS) - multi-tenant payments platform serving 30,000+ terminals (client: Invenco by GVR)
- Shipped timezone-aware config and firmware rollouts to 30,000+ FlexPay terminals via EventBridge-scheduled Node.js Lambda services in off-peak windows, cutting update-related disruptions 60%.
- Designed device tenant app feature-flag and settings resolution in Node.js on PostgreSQL, with a JSON-Schema-validated registry and audited upserts, powering per-terminal behavior fleet-wide.
- Implemented dual-approval and HSM content-signing APIs (MFA-gated state machine, 3-level key validation) securing firmware releases for G6/G7 terminal families.
- Replaced a 4-table authorization join with a single PostgreSQL materialized-view lookup (refresh-on-mutation) across 10,000 users, 500 groups, and 50,000 entities.
- Built the Debezium Kafka (MSK) CDC pipeline standardizing device data into 9 downstream systems - idempotent upserts, Kinesis S3 Parquet tiering - plus media distribution to terminals.
- Cut ambiguous production errors from 100% to under 5% with a machine-readable error taxonomy across 4 services, taking config-issue resolution from days to hours.
- Root-caused 15+ production incidents - an N+1 hot path cut from 8-12s to under 800ms, a silent NULL bug dropping 118,933 devices, 1M-row exports at ~1 MB constant memory via pg-query-stream.

experiences.job_description:

- Decomposed the monolith into Dockerized Node.js microservices on Kubernetes-based Azure Container Apps and Azure Functions (Container App Jobs, ClickHouse, Cosmos DB), removing cross-team deploy dependencies.
- Cut analytics storage 7 and query load 60% by re-partitioning the event-tracking schema and tuning ClickHouse queries across open/click/bounce pipelines.
- Built integration services for MoEngage, CleverTap, WebEngage, Shopify, and Zapier - webhook/event delivery and transactional triggers.
